# Code of Conduct

Power Pilot is maintained by Vellium. Participation in this repository is
limited to authorized collaborators, invited reviewers, and customers who are
reporting an issue in good faith.

## Expected behavior

- Discuss code, behavior, and evidence rather than people.
- Assume good faith and ask clarifying questions before escalating.
- Keep security reports private until a coordinated disclosure date is agreed.
- Remove customer data, API keys, tokens, certificates, and personal information
  from issues, pull requests, logs, and screenshots.
- Respect licensing, confidentiality, and embargo obligations.

## Unacceptable behavior

- Harassment, discrimination, threats, or personal attacks.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Disclosing a vulnerability before the agreed disclosure date.
- Submitting malware, credential-stealing code, or intentionally destructive
  changes.
- Ignoring repeated requests to keep a discussion technical and on topic.

## Scope

This policy applies to repository issues, pull requests, reviews, discussions,
commit messages, and private communication about the project.

## Reporting and enforcement

Report conduct concerns to <contact@vellium.dev> (or <legal@vellium.dev>). Maintainers may edit or remove
content, close or lock threads, reject contributions, or restrict access.
Reports will be handled as confidentially as practical. Retaliation against a
good-faith reporter is itself a violation.
